SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS checked_at_ist,(SELECT count(*) FROM mrp_price_history) AS mrp_count,(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(row_text,E'
' ORDER BY row_text COLLATE "C"),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_array(item_code,to_char(effective_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),variant,encode(float8send(mrp),'hex'),encode(float8send(net_price),'hex'),encode(float8send(discount_pct),'hex'),price_basis)::text AS row_text FROM mrp_price_history) v) AS mrp_value_sha256,(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_products) AS catalogue_count,(SELECT md5(string_agg(row_to_json(p)::text,'|' ORDER BY id)) FROM catalog_products p) AS catalogue_full_md5,(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(jsonb_build_array(item_code,category,series_range,division)::text,E'
' ORDER BY item_code COLLATE "C"),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM catalog_products) AS classification_sha256
note: Pre-code checksums prove unchanged data. Raw classification baseline CSVs were archived after implementation, anchored by those matching pre-code hashes; subsequent raw CSV archives are byte-identical. Production feature behavior remains pending user publication.
